perfume.answer: Royal Air Maroc authorises perfumes and colognes subject to strict volume limits per container and per passenger, without giving figures. Liquids and creams in the cabin must be in containers of 100 ml or less inside a transparent 20 cm by 20 cm bag.

sections.h: 🧴 What Royal Air Maroc says about perfume
sections.p: From the "Baggage restrictions" block of the Royal Air Maroc Special baggage page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Royal Air Maroc rule
rows: Authorised with strict volume limits per container and per passenger
100 ml or less per container, in a transparent 20 cm by 20 cm bag
Listed among restricted items on the baggage information page

list: Not on the page: the exact per-container and per-passenger volumes. Confirm with Royal Air Maroc.

faq: Can I take perfume on Royal Air Maroc?
Yes within strict per-container and per-passenger volume limits, which the page does not give in numbers.
Are aerosols allowed on Royal Air Maroc?
The baggage information page lists compressed gases such as aerosols among restricted items.
